mentions.name: Nonoverse
mentions.description: Nonoverse is a free, offline, ad-free iOS nonogram puzzle game with about 60 levels. New quality-of-life improvements, additional puzzles, and a better tutorial are in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Nonoverse (iOS, free, offline, no ads), a nonogram puzzle game: https://apps.apple.com/app/nonoverse-nonogram-puzzles/id6748441182

I’m working on some more QoL and adding more puzzles, I’m surprised how quickly everyone completes the current ~60 levels. A better tutorial is in the works too.
